build_repeated_scalar_container: build a RepeatedScalarFieldContainer to hold type-checked repeated scalar protobuf fields like int32 or string
build_repeated_composite_container: build a RepeatedCompositeFieldContainer to hold repeated composite protobuf message fields with add and append
build_scalar_map: build a ScalarMap dict-like container for protobuf map fields with scalar keys and scalar values
build_message_map: build a MessageMap dict-like container for protobuf map fields with scalar keys and submessage values
build_unknown_field_set: build an UnknownFieldSet to store and manage parsed unknown protobuf fields with field numbers and wire types
